description: This file implements the FooPlugin class for the WPEFramework plugin infrastructure, including initialization, registration, and a persistent key-value store interface.

classes.name: FooPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Handles registration of JSON-RPC methods and manages persistent key-value store updates and notifications.

methods.name: FooPlugin::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, loads configuration, manages a file for storage, and opens the database connection.

methods.name: FooPlugin::Deinitialize
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks when the plugin is deinitialized (currently empty).

methods.name: FooPlugin::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information (currently an empty string).

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the persistent store and responds with success or error message.

methods.name: PersistentStore::event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Triggers a notification when a key-value pair has changed.
